title: jasonia iphionoides
intro: Jasonia iphionoides, commonly known as 'Greek chamomile', is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Jasonia iphionoides include its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. Therapeutically, it is known to exhibit spasmolytic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Jasonia iphionoides include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
